wordpos_crf.description: Controlled Track 4 ablation retaining the full DualRoPE-CRF-v7 encoder, direct 16-class emissions, CRF, data, optimizer, and schedule. It adds learned forward and reverse within-word character-position embeddings plus word-initial and word-final flags at the encoder input.

factorized_crf.description: Controlled Track 4 ablation retaining DualRoPE-CRF-v7 while replacing its unconstrained 16-class emission projection with base-diacritic and Shadda heads whose normalized log-probabilities form the 16 CRF emissions. The CRF NLL remains the only training objective.

low_rank_boundary_crf.description: Controlled Track 4 ablation retaining DualRoPE-CRF-v7 and adding a rank-2 residual to the shared transition matrix only when entering a new word. This tests boundary conditioning with 64 extra parameters instead of a separate unconstrained 16x16 boundary matrix.
